waehlt das Modell auf der Achse `quantity` aus der Liste, mit der
Definition aus oeo-closure.owl vor sich, als deutsche Zeile (`gloss`). Vorher stand hier je Klasse ein
eigener Parameter und danach eine Stichworttabelle, die deutsche
Indikatorbezeichnungen auf die Klassen abbildete. Die Tabelle traf die
Schreibweisen des Korpus nicht, und der Harvest fragte jede Quelle
viermal, was das Modell einlud, die CO2-Frage mit einer Energiezahl zu
beantworten: 95 der 218 an dieser Stelle verworfenen Werte waren
Die Einheitenfamilie trennt die Zahlparameter: Wh gegen t gegen W.
Innerhalb der Einheitenfamilie waehlt das Modell die Klasse.
`quantity` ist NICHT required: was in keine Klasse passt, behaelt seinen
Wortlaut in quantity_raw und wird gezaehlt, statt verworfen zu werden.
unit_question: Welche Einheit druckt der Plan für diese Zahl, und sagt die Stelle, dass die Menge je Jahr gilt?
parameter_question: Um WELCHE Kennzahl handelt es sich bei dieser Zahl? Entscheide danach, was die Quelle über sie sagt: die Einheit, die Spalten- oder Zeilenbeschriftung und die Tabellen- oder Abschnittsüberschrift. Eine Angabe in t CO2 ist eine Emission, eine Angabe in MWh oder GWh ein Energieverbrauch. Zitiere die Stelle, aus der das hervorgeht. Eine Angabe in kW, MW oder GW ist eine Leistung. Eine Angabe in % ist ein Anteil. Eine Zahl von Gebäuden ist eine Gebäudeanzahl.

parameters.label: Energieverbrauch
parameters.description: Eine im Wärmeplan bilanzierte Energiemenge, je Energieträger, Sektor und Jahr. Welche Größe es ist, wählst du in "quantity" aus der Liste. Die Ontologie definiert die beiden Klassen so: final energy consumption value ist "the energy delivered to and consumed by end users". Darunter fällt BEIDES, was ein deutscher Wärmeplan Verbrauch nennt und was er Bedarf nennt: für ein Zielszenario ist nichts gemessen, jede Zahl ist gerechnet, und die Definition spricht nicht von Messung. Ein Wärmebedarf, ein Endenergiebedarf und ein zu deckender Wärmebedarf sind also diese Klasse. primary energy consumption value ist "the total consumption of energy in a spatial region excluding the non-energetic use of fuels", also die Bilanz vor der Umwandlung. Ein Potenzial ist "a maximum value that describes some upper limit in a spatial region of reference", also ein erschließbares Maximum und keine verbrauchte Menge. Die Ontologie unterscheidet theoretisches, technisches (technological), wirtschaftliches (economic), erschließbares (developable) und nachhaltiges (sustainable) Potenzial, jeweils als flow potential (eine Menge je Zeit) oder als stock potential (ein Bestand, etwa eine Speichermenge). Wähle die Art, die die Quelle druckt; nennt sie keine Art, wähle flow potential für eine Menge je Zeit (etwa MWh/a), stock potential für einen Bestand und potential nur, wenn auch das offen ist. Jede Zahl mit einer Energieeinheit ist nach der Ontologie ein energy value, "a quantity value that has an energy unit as unit": auch eine Erzeugung, eine Nutzenergie oder eine Einsparung. Die Liste trägt alle Klassen der Ontologie darunter; wähle die genaueste, deren Definition die Zahl trifft. Die Einträge out: sind Zahlen, für die die Ontologie keine Klasse hat, etwa ein Wert je Einwohner. Das ist ein richtiges Ergebnis, kein Fehler.
parameters.brief: Eine Energiemenge, die der Wärmeplan bilanziert, je Energieträger, Sektor und Jahr: Verbrauch oder Bedarf, End- oder Primärenergie, ein Potenzial, Nutzenergie, Erzeugung oder Einsparung.

OEO_00050016.label: final energy consumption value
OEO_00050016.definition: A final energy consumption value is an energy consumption value expressing the magnitude of the energy delivered to and consumed by end users.
OEO_00050016.gloss: Endenergieverbrauch oder Endenergiebedarf: Menge der an Endverbraucher gelieferten und von ihnen verbrauchten Energie, gemessen oder gerechnet, auch ein Wärmebedarf.

OEO_00050018.label: primary energy consumption value
OEO_00050018.definition: A primary energy consumption value is an energy consumption value expressing the magnitude of the total consumption of energy in a spatial region excluding the non-energetic use of fuels.
OEO_00050018.gloss: Primärenergieverbrauch: Gesamter Energieverbrauch in einer Region ohne nicht-energetische Nutzung, die Bilanz vor der Umwandlung.

OEO_00290000.label: potential
OEO_00290000.definition: A potential is a maximum value that describes some upper limit in a spatial region of reference.
OEO_00290000.gloss: Potenzial: Ein Maximalwert, der eine Obergrenze in einem Referenzgebiet beschreibt.

OEO_00140056.label: flow potential
OEO_00140056.definition: A flow potential is a potential of an input or output of a process, per time unit.
OEO_00140056.gloss: Flusspotenzial: Potenzial eines Prozessinputs oder -outputs pro Zeiteinheit.

OEO_00140057.label: theoretical flow potential
OEO_00140057.definition: A theoretical flow potential is a type of flow potential that identifies the physical upper limit of an input or output of a process in a spatial region of reference per unit time.
OEO_00140057.gloss: Theoretisches Flusspotenzial: Physikalische Obergrenze eines Prozessinputs oder -outputs pro Zeiteinheit.

OEO_00140058.label: technological flow potential
OEO_00140058.definition: A technological flow potential is a type of a flow potential derived from a theoretical flow potential, taking account of the annual efficiency of the respective conversion technology and the additional restrictions regarding the area that is realistically available for energy generation.
OEO_00140058.gloss: Technologisches Flusspotenzial: Theoretisches Potenzial unter Berücksichtigung von Technologieeffizienz und verfügbarer Fläche.

OEO_00140059.label: economic flow potential
OEO_00140059.definition: An economic flow potential is a type of flow potential that identifies the proportion of the technological potential that can be utilised economically (based on economic boundary conditions).
OEO_00140059.gloss: Wirtschaftliches Flusspotenzial: Der Anteil des technologischen Potenzials, der wirtschaftlich nutzbar ist.

OEO_00140060.label: developable flow potential
OEO_00140060.definition: A developable flow potential is a type of flow potential that describes the fraction of the economic potential that can be developed under realistic conditions (regulations, environmental and social restrictions).
OEO_00140060.gloss: Erschließbares Flusspotenzial: Der Anteil des wirtschaftlichen Potenzials unter realistischen Rahmenbedingungen.

OEO_00140061.label: sustainable flow potential
OEO_00140061.definition: A sustainable flow potential is a type of flow potential that takes into account all aspects of sustainability, which usually requires careful consideration and evaluation of different ecological and socio-economic aspects. The differentiation of the sustainable potential is blurred, since ecological aspects may already have been considered for the technological or economic potential, depending on the author.
OEO_00140061.gloss: Nachhaltiges Flusspotenzial: Potenzial unter Berücksichtigung aller ökologischen und sozioökonomischen Aspekte.

OEO_00140062.label: stock potential
OEO_00140062.definition: A stock potential is a potential of the stock of a source or sink.
OEO_00140062.gloss: Bestandspotenzial: Potenzial des Bestands einer Quelle oder Senke.

OEO_00140063.label: theoretical stock potential
OEO_00140063.definition: A theoretical stock potential is a type of stock potential that identifies the physical upper limit of a stock of a source or sink in a spatial region of reference.
OEO_00140063.gloss: Theoretisches Bestandspotenzial: Physikalische Obergrenze eines Quellen- oder Senkenbestands.

OEO_00140064.label: technological stock potential
OEO_00140064.definition: A technological stock potential is a type of a stock potential derived from a theoretical stock potential, taking account of the annual efficiency of the respective conversion technology and the additional restrictions regarding the area that is realistically available for energy generation.
OEO_00140064.gloss: Technologisches Bestandspotenzial: Theoretisches Potenzial unter Berücksichtigung von Technologieeffizienz und verfügbarer Fläche.

OEO_00140065.label: economic stock potential
OEO_00140065.definition: An economic stock potential is a type of stock potential that identifies the proportion of the technological potential that can be utilised economically (based on economic boundary conditions).
OEO_00140065.gloss: Wirtschaftliches Bestandspotenzial: Der Anteil des technologischen Potenzials, der wirtschaftlich nutzbar ist.

OEO_00140066.label: developable stock potential
OEO_00140066.definition: A developable stock potential is a type of stock potential that describes the fraction of the economic potential that can be developed under realistic conditions (regulations, environmental and social restrictions).
OEO_00140066.gloss: Erschließbares Bestandspotenzial: Der Anteil des wirtschaftlichen Potenzials unter realistischen Rahmenbedingungen.

OEO_00140067.label: sustainable stock potential
OEO_00140067.definition: A sustainable stock potential is a type of stock potential that takes into account all aspects of sustainability, which usually requires careful consideration and evaluation of different ecological and socio-economic aspects. The differentiation of the sustainable potential is blurred, since ecological aspects may already have been considered for the technological or economic potential, depending on the author.
OEO_00140067.gloss: Nachhaltiges Bestandspotenzial: Potenzial unter Berücksichtigung aller ökologischen und sozioökonomischen Aspekte.

OEO_00010075.label: Energie je Fläche
OEO_00010075.definition: An areal energy density is a quantity value that states a certain energy amount per area.

OEO_00010077.label: Solarenergie je Fläche
OEO_00010077.definition: An areal solar energy density is an areal energy density that gives the arriving solar energy per area. A synonym for areal solar energy density is irradiation.

OEO_00020204.label: elektrische Energiemenge
OEO_00020204.definition: An electrical energy amount value is an energy amount value that measures a quantity of electrical energy.

OEO_00020205.label: Stromimport
OEO_00020205.definition: An electricity import value is an electrical energy amount value that measures the import of electrical energy.

OEO_00020206.label: Stromexport
OEO_00020206.definition: An electricity export value is an electrical energy amount value that measures the export of electrical energy.

OEO_00050017.label: Bruttoinlandsverbrauch
OEO_00050017.definition: A gross inland energy consumption value is an energy consumption value expressing the magnitude of the total consumption of energy in a spatial region (e.g. a country).

OEO_00050019.label: Energiemenge
OEO_00050019.definition: An energy value is a quantity value that has an energy unit as unit.

OEO_00230000.label: Speicherkapazität
OEO_00230000.definition: An energy storage capacity is the quantity value stating the maximum energy an energy storage object can store.

OEO_00240018.label: Bruttostromverbrauch
OEO_00240018.definition: A gross national electricity consumption value is an energy consumption value measuring the consumption of electrical energy in a spatial region (e.g. a country), including gross electricity generation plus electricity imports, minus electricity exports. It is part of the gross inland energy consumption.

OEO_00240019.label: Energieverbrauch
OEO_00240019.definition: An energy consumption value is an energy amount value that measures the energy consumption over a time span.

OEO_00330012.label: Speicherinhalt
OEO_00330012.definition: An energy storage content is an energy amount value that measures the quantity of energy stored in an energy storage object.

spellings: Summe oder Integral über einen Zeitraum oder ein Gebiet

OEO_00140070.gloss: Summe oder Integral von Werten innerhalb eines Zeitraums oder Gebiets, etwa eine Jahressumme, der Normalfall.

OEO_00140071.label: arithmetic mean
OEO_00140071.definition: average value calculated by arithmetic mean over a set of data values, e.g. within a time step or spatial region
OEO_00140071.gloss: Durchschnittswert, berechnet als arithmetisches Mittel über Datensätze.

OEO_00140069.label: instantaneous
OEO_00140069.definition: value measured at or modelled for exactly one 0-dim temporal region, referenced by a time stamp, e.g. to represent a time step in a time series
OEO_00140069.gloss: Wert, der exakt zu einem zeitlichen Nullpunkt gemessen oder modelliert wird.

OEO_00140073.definition: maximum value within a set of data values, e.g. in a time step or spatial region
OEO_00140073.gloss: Höchster Wert innerhalb einer Menge von Datenwerten in einem Bereich.

OEO_00140072.gloss: Niedrigster Wert innerhalb einer Menge von Datenwerten in einem Bereich.

OEO_00000292.label: Erdgas
OEO_00000292.definition: Natural gas is a gas mixture occurring in underground deposits, whether liquefied or gaseous, and consisting mainly of methane.
OEO_00000292.gloss: Erdgas: Gasgemisch aus unterirdischen Lagerstätten, das hauptsächlich aus Methan besteht.

OEO_00000211.label: Heizöl
OEO_00000211.definition: Heating oil is gas diesel oil for industrial and commercial uses, marine diesel and diesel used in rail traffic, other gas oil, including heavy gas oils which distil between 380 °C and 540 °C and which are used as petrochemical feedstocks.
OEO_00000211.gloss: Heizöl: Gasöl für industrielle und gewerbliche Zwecke, auch schwere Gasöle, die als petrochemische Rohstoffe dienen.

OEO_00000132.label: Fernwärme
OEO_00000132.definition: District heating is a grid-bound heating transfer to residential or commercial buildings.
OEO_00000132.gloss: Fernwärme: Leitungsgebundene Wärmelieferung an Wohn- oder Gewerbegebäude.

OEO_00000139.label: Strom
OEO_00000139.definition: Electrical energy is a form of energy derived from the potential or kinetic energy of charged particles.
OEO_00000139.gloss: Elektrische Energie aus geladenen Teilchen, unterscheidet sich als nicht-materieller Energieträger.

OEO_00000449.label: Holz
OEO_00000449.definition: Wood is a biomass from trees. It has a solid state of matter an can be used as fuel.
OEO_00000449.gloss: Holz: Biomasse von Bäumen in festem Aggregatzustand, die als Brennstoff genutzt werden kann.

OEO_00000074.label: Biogas
OEO_00000074.definition: Biogas is a gas mixture produced by anaerobic digestion. It consists mainly of methane and carbon dioxide and can be used as fuel.
OEO_00000074.gloss: Biogas: Durch anaerobe Vergärung entstehendes Gasgemisch aus hauptsächlich Methan und Kohlendioxid, das als Brennstoff dient.

OEO_00000388.label: Solarthermie
OEO_00000388.definition: Solar thermal energy is thermal energy that is the physical output of a solar thermal energy transformation.
OEO_00000388.gloss: Solarthermie: Wärmeenergie, die als Ergebnis einer solarthermischen Energieumwandlung entsteht.

OEO_00000251.label: Braunkohle
OEO_00000251.definition: Lignite is coal that is non-agglomerating with a gross calorific value less than 17 435 kJ/kg (4 165 kcal/kg) and greater than 31 % volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.
OEO_00000251.gloss: Braunkohle: Nicht backende Kohle mit einem Brennwert unter 17 435 kJ/kg und über 31 % flüchtigen Bestandteilen.

OEO_00320011.label: Flüssiggas
OEO_00320011.definition: Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) is gas mixture of hydrocarbon gases, mainly propane and butane.
OEO_00320011.gloss: Flüssiggasgemisch aus Propan und Butan, unterscheidet sich als fossiler Gasbrennstoff.

OEO_00000220.label: Wasserstoff
OEO_00000220.definition: Hydrogen is a portion of matter with the chemical formula H2. It has a gaseous normal state of matter. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.
OEO_00000220.gloss: Wasserstoff: Stoff mit der chemischen Formel H2, der gasförmig vorliegt und als Brennstoff verwendet werden kann.

OEO_00000204.label: Steinkohle
OEO_00000204.definition: Hard coal is coal with a gross calorific value greater than 23 865 kJ/kg (5 700 kcal/kg) on an ashfree but moist basis and with a mean random reflectance of vitrinite of at least 0,6.
OEO_00000204.gloss: Steinkohle: Kohle mit einem Brennwert über 23 865 kJ/kg und einer mittleren Vitrinitreflexion von mindestens 0,6.

OEO_00010215.label: Biomethan
OEO_00010215.definition: Biomethane is a gas mixture produced from biogas by removing carbon dioxide. It consists mainly of methane and can be used as fuel.
OEO_00010215.gloss: Biomethan: Aus Biogas durch Abtrennung von Kohlendioxid gewonnenes Gasgemisch aus hauptsächlich Methan, das als Brennstoff dient.

OEO_00000332.label: biogener Festbrennstoff
OEO_00000332.definition: Solid biomass is a portion of matter consisting of organic, non-fossil material of biological origin which may be used as fuel for heat production or electricity generation.
OEO_00000332.gloss: Biogener Festbrennstoff: Organisches, nicht fossiles Material biologischen Ursprungs, das zur Wärme- oder Stromerzeugung genutzt werden kann.

OEO_00010214.label: Biomasse
OEO_00010214.definition: Biomass is a portion of matter from plants or animals and has thus has a biogenic origin.
OEO_00010214.gloss: Biomasse: Stoff pflanzlichen oder tierischen Ursprungs und damit biogener Herkunft.

OEO_00000088.label: Kohle
OEO_00000088.definition: Coal is a portion of matter consisting of combustible black or brownish-black sedimentary rock, formed as rock strata called coal seams.
OEO_00000088.gloss: Kohle: Brennbares schwarzes bis schwarzbraunes Sedimentgestein, das in Flözen entstanden ist.

OEO_00000290.label: Siedlungsabfälle
OEO_00000290.definition: A municipal waste fuel is waste fuel produced by households or non-industrial commercial activities.
OEO_00000290.gloss: Siedlungsabfälle: Abfallbrennstoff aus Haushalten oder nicht-industriellen gewerblichen Tätigkeiten.

OEO_00000356.label: biogener Siedlungsabfall
OEO_00000356.definition: A biogenic municipal waste fuel is a municipal waste fuel that has a biogenic origin.
OEO_00000356.gloss: Siedlungsabfall mit biogenem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich durch die biologische Herkunft.

OEO_00000439.label: Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00000439.definition: A waste fuel is a fuel in which the material entity is waste.
OEO_00000439.gloss: Brennstoff, bei dem das Material Abfall ist, umfasst alle Abfallarten.

OEO_00020495.label: landwirtschaftlicher Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00020495.definition: An angricultural waste fuel is waste fuel produced by agriculture.
OEO_00020495.gloss: Landwirtschaftlicher Abfallbrennstoff: Abfallbrennstoff aus der Landwirtschaft.

OEO_00010155.label: synthetische Gase
OEO_00010155.definition: A gaseous synthetic fuel is a synthetic fuel that has a gaseous state of matter under normal conditions.
OEO_00010155.gloss: Synthetische Gase: Synthetischer Brennstoff, der unter Normalbedingungen gasförmig ist.

OEO_00000191.label: Geothermie
OEO_00000191.definition: Geothermal energy is thermal energy that is released from within the earth's crust.
OEO_00000191.gloss: Geothermie: Wärmeenergie, die aus dem Inneren der Erdkruste freigesetzt wird.

OEO_00010114.label: Abwärme
OEO_00010114.definition: Waste thermal energy is thermal energy that is the physical output of an energy transformation process and that is released into the environment unused.
OEO_00010114.gloss: Abwärme: Wärmeenergie, die bei einem Energieumwandlungsprozess entsteht und ungenutzt an die Umwelt abgegeben wird.

OEO_00310004.label: industrielle Abwärme
OEO_00310004.definition: Industrial waste thermal energy is waste thermal energy that is energy output of some industrial process.
OEO_00310004.gloss: Industrielle Abwärme: Abwärme, die als Energieausgabe eines industriellen Prozesses entsteht.

OEO_00000056.label: Umweltwärme
OEO_00000056.definition: Ambient thermal energy is thermal energy that is stored in the ambient air, beneath the surface of solid earth or in surface water. It is captured by heat pumps.
OEO_00000056.gloss: In Luft, Erde oder Wasser gespeicherte Wärme, die durch Wärmepumpen genutzt wird.

OEO_00140105.label: anthropogene Umweltwärme
OEO_00140105.definition: Artificial ambient thermal energy is ambient thermal energy that has an anthropogenic origin.
OEO_00140105.gloss: Umweltwärme mit anthropogenem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich durch menschliche Entstehung.

OEO_00140104.label: natürliche Umweltwärme
OEO_00140104.definition: Natural ambient thermal energy is ambient thermal energy that has a renewable origin.
OEO_00140104.gloss: Umweltwärme mit erneuerbarem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich durch natürliche Herkunft.

OEO_00010223.label: biogener Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00010223.definition: A biogenic waste fuel is a waste fuel that has a biogenic origin.
OEO_00010223.gloss: Abfallbrennstoff mit biogenem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich als spezifische Abfallart.

OEO_00000014.label: fossiler Brennstoff
OEO_00000014.definition: A fossil combustion fuel is a combustion fuel with the origin fossil.

OEO_00000025.label: Methan
OEO_00000025.definition: Methane is a hydrocarbon with the chemical formula CH4. It has a gaseous normal state of matter. It occurs naturally in the atmosphere as a trace gas and can work as a greenhouse gas. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.

OEO_00000033.label: erneuerbarer Brennstoff
OEO_00000033.definition: A renewable fuel is a fuel that has a renewable origin and an renewable energy carrier disposition

OEO_00000040.label: Uran
OEO_00000040.definition: Uranium is a portion of matter that has the atomic number 92. It is a silver-grey metal.

OEO_00000054.label: Luft
OEO_00000054.definition: Air is a gas mixture that forms the Earth's atmosphere.

OEO_00000058.label: Anthrazit
OEO_00000058.definition: Anthracite is a hard coal with a high caloric value due to its high carbon content (about 90 % fixed carbon).

OEO_00000062.label: Erdölbegleitgas
OEO_00000062.definition: Associated gas is a natural gas that is a byproduct from crude oil exploitation.

OEO_00000066.label: Flugbenzin
OEO_00000066.definition: Aviation gasoline is gasoline used as motor spirit and prepared especially for aviation piston engines, with an octane number suited to the engine, a freezing point of -60 °C and a distillation range usually within the limits of 30 °C and 180 °C.

OEO_00000071.label: Biodiesel
OEO_00000071.definition: Biodiesel is a portion of matter that has a liquid state of matter and has a diesel fuel role. It is produced from plants or animals and thus has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00000072.label: Biobrennstoff
OEO_00000072.definition: A biofuel is a combustion fuel that has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00000075.label: Bio-Ottokraftstoff
OEO_00000075.definition: Biogasoline is a portion of matter that has a liquid state of matter and has a gasoline fuel role. It consists of bioethanol, biomethanol and products of these two substances. It is made from vegetable or animal material and thus has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00000077.label: Gichtgas
OEO_00000077.definition: Blast furnace gas is manufactured coal based gas produced during the combustion of coke in blast furnaces in the iron and steel industry. It is recovered and used as a fuel partly within the plant and partly in other steel industry processes or in power stations equipped to burn it. The quantity of fuel should be reported on a gross calorific value basis.

OEO_00000084.label: Holzkohle
OEO_00000084.definition: Charcoal is a portion of matter produced from wood via pyrolysis. It has a solid state of matter and can be used as fuel.

OEO_00000093.label: Kokereigas
OEO_00000093.definition: Coke oven gas is manufactured coal based gas obtained as a by-product of the manufacture of coke oven coke for the production of iron and steel.

OEO_00000094.label: Kokskohle
OEO_00000094.definition: Coking coal is hard coal that is bituminous with a quality that allows the production of a coke suitable to support a blast furnace charge. Its gross calorific value is greater than 23 865 kJ/kg (5 700 kcal/kg) on an ash-free but moist basis.

OEO_00000096.label: Grubengas
OEO_00000096.definition: Colliery gas is natural gas found in coal mines (British English: colliery). The main component is methane. Synonyms are firedamp, mine gas. It is used as a fossil fuel.

OEO_00000099.label: Verbrennungsbrennstoff
OEO_00000099.definition: A combustion fuel is a fuel that realises its fuel role in processes that release energy in the form of heat or work by chemical reaction with other substances.

OEO_00000102.label: Druckluft
OEO_00000102.definition: Compressed air is air that has been compressed to store energy. To discharge energy, the air is expanded.

OEO_00000115.label: Rohöl
OEO_00000115.definition: Crude oil is a portion of mater of fossil origin comprising a mixture of hydrocarbons and associated impurities, such as sulphur. It exists in the liquid phase under normal surface temperature and pressure and its physical characteristics (density, viscosity, etc.) are highly variable. This category includes field or lease condensate recovered from associated and non-associated gas where it is commingled with the commercial crude oil stream.

OEO_00000131.label: fossiler Dieselkraftstoff
OEO_00000131.definition: Diesel fuel is gas diesel oil used on-road for diesel compression ignition (cars, trucks, etc.), usually of low sulphur content.

OEO_00000173.label: Brennstoff
OEO_00000173.definition: A fuel is a portion of matter that has the disposition to be an energy carrier and that has a fuel role.

OEO_00000181.label: Gasöl
OEO_00000181.definition: Gas/diesel oil is a portion of matter that is primarily a medium distillate distilling between 180 °C and 380 °C. Includes blending components. Several grades are available depending on uses.

OEO_00000183.label: Benzin
OEO_00000183.definition: Gasoline (American English) or petrol (British English) is a portion of matter in the form of a transparent petroleum-derived liquid that is used primarily as a fuel in spark-ignited internal combustion engines. It consists mostly of organic compounds obtained by the fractional distillation of petroleum, enhanced with a variety of additives.

OEO_00000186.label: Stadtgas
OEO_00000186.definition:
Gasworks gas is manufactured coal based gas that covers all types of gases produced in public utility or private plants, whose main purpose is manufacture, transport and distribution of gas. It includes gas produced by carbonisation (including gas produced by coke ovens and transferred to gasworks gas), by total gasification with or without enrichment with oil products (LPG, residual fuel oil, etc.), and by reforming and simple mixing of gases and/or air, reported under the rows ‘from other sources’. Under the transformation sector identify amounts of gasworks gas transferred to blended natural gas which will be distributed and consumed through the natural gas grid.

The production of other coal gases (i.e. coke oven gas, blast furnace gas and oxygen steel furnace gas) should be reported in the columns concerning such gases, and not as production of gasworks gas. The coal gases transferred to gasworks plants should then be reported (in their own column) in the transformation sector in the gasworks plants row. The total amount of gasworks gas resulting from transfers of other coal gases should appear in the production line for gasworks gas.

OEO_00000226.label: Industrieabfallbrennstoff
OEO_00000226.definition: An industrial waste fuel is waste fuel produced by industry.

OEO_00000245.label: Düsenkraftstoff
OEO_00000245.definition: Jet fuel is kerosene used for aviation turbine power units. It has the same distillation characteristics between 150 °C and 300 °C (generally not above 250 °C) and flash point as kerosene. In addition, it has particular specifications (such as freezing point) which are established by the International Air Transport Association (IATA).

OEO_00000246.label: Kerosin
OEO_00000246.definition:
Kerosene, also known as paraffin, lamp oil, and coal oil (an obsolete term), is a portion of matter consisting of combustible hydrocarbon liquid which is derived from petroleum. It is widely used as a fuel in industry as well as households. It is sometimes spelled kerosine in scientific and industrial usage.
[...]

Kerosene is widely used to power jet engines of aircraft (jet fuel) and some rocket engines and is also commonly used as a cooking and lighting fuel and for fire toys such as poi. In parts of Asia, kerosene is sometimes used as fuel for small outboard motors or even motorcycles.

OEO_00000257.label: Flüssigluft
OEO_00000257.definition: Liquid air is air that has a liquid state of matter.

OEO_00000258.label: flüssiger Biobrennstoff
OEO_00000258.definition: A liquid biofuel is a biofuel that has liquid as its normal state of matter.

OEO_00000263.label: Gas aus Kohle
OEO_00000263.definition: A manufactured coal based gas is a gas mixture that is manufactured from coal. It is used as fossil fuel.

OEO_00000286.label: Motorenbenzin
OEO_00000286.definition:
Motor gasoline is gasoline consisting of a mixture of light hydrocarbons distilling between 35 °C and 215 °C. It is used as a fuel for land based spark ignition engines. Motor gasoline may include additives, oxygenates and octane enhancers, including lead compounds such as TEL and TML.

Includes motor gasoline blending components (excluding additives/oxygenates), e.g. alkylates, isomerate, reformate, cracked gasoline destined for use as finished motor gasoline.

OEO_00000297.label: Erdgas aus reinen Gasfeldern
OEO_00000297.definition: Non associated gas is natural gas originating from fields producing hydrocarbons only in gaseous form.

OEO_00000299.label: fossiler Siedlungsabfall
OEO_00000299.definition: A fossil municipal waste fuel is an municipal waste fuel that has a fossil origin.

OEO_00000302.label: Kernbrennstoff
OEO_00000302.definition: A nuclear fuel is a fuel that realises its fuel role in processes that release energy in the form of heat or work by undergoing nuclear fission.

OEO_00000320.label: Torf
OEO_00000320.definition: Peat is a or portion of matter that is a soft, porous or compressed, sedimentary deposit of plant origin with high water content (up to 90 % in the raw state) and can be used as combustion fuel. As the natural formation of peat takes at least centuries, peat is usually considered having a fossil origin.

OEO_00000345.label: hochgepumptes Wasser
OEO_00000345.definition: Pumped water is liquid water which was pumped into an upper reservoir and thus contains potential energy.

OEO_00000391.label: fester fossiler Brennstoff
OEO_00000391.definition: A solid fossil fuel is a fossil fuel that has a solid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00000401.label: subbituminöse Kohle
OEO_00000401.definition: Sub bituminous coal is coal that is non-agglomerating with a gross calorific value between 17 435 kJ/kg (4 165 kcal/kg) and 23 865 kJ/kg (5 700 kcal/kg) containing more than 31 % volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

OEO_00000441.label: Wasser
OEO_00000441.definition: Water is a portion of matter with the chemical formula H2O. It has a liquid normal state of matter.

OEO_00010000.label: Ammoniak
OEO_00010000.definition: Ammonia is a portion of matter with the chemical formula NH3. It has a gaseous normal state of matter and can act as an air pollutant. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.

OEO_00010015.label: fossiler Wasserstoff
OEO_00010015.definition: Fossil hydrogen is hydrogen with fossil origin.

OEO_00010016.label: synthetischer Wasserstoff
OEO_00010016.definition: Synthetic hydrogen is hydrogen with synthetic origin.

OEO_00010017.label: synthetischer Brennstoff
OEO_00010017.definition: A synthetic fuel is a fuel produced from one or more portion(s) of matter using electric energy.

OEO_00010018.label: synthetisches Methan
OEO_00010018.definition: Synthetic methane is methane that has a synthetic origin.

OEO_00010019.label: PtL-Kraftstoff
OEO_00010019.definition: PtL fuel is a liquid synthetic fuel produced in a power-to-liquid system from water and carbon dioxide using electrical energy.

OEO_00010093.label: Fluss
OEO_00010093.definition: A river is a water body that moves through permanent or seasonal flow process from elevated land towards lower elevations through a definite channel and empties either into a sea, lake, or another river or ends on land as bed seepage and evapotranspiration exceed water supply.

OEO_00010104.label: Gewässer
OEO_00010104.definition: A water body is an accumulation of liquid water of varying size on the surface of the Earth.

OEO_00010105.label: Ozean
OEO_00010105.definition: The ocean is a water body that consists of salt water and is covering approximately 71% of Earth's surface.

OEO_00010144.label: fester Brennstoff
OEO_00010144.definition: A solid combustion fuel is a combustion fuel that has a solid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010145.label: flüssiger Brennstoff
OEO_00010145.definition: A liquid combustion fuel is a combustion fuel that has a liquid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010146.label: gasförmiger Brennstoff
OEO_00010146.definition: A gaseous combustion fuel is a combustion fuel that has a gaseous state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010147.label: flüssiger fossiler Brennstoff
OEO_00010147.definition: A liquid fossil fuel is a fossil combustion fuel that has a liquid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010148.label: gasförmiger fossiler Brennstoff
OEO_00010148.definition: A gaseous fossil fuel is a fossil combustion fuel that has a gaseous state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010149.label: fester erneuerbarer Brennstoff
OEO_00010149.definition: A solid renewable fuel is a renewable fuel that has a solid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010150.label: flüssiger erneuerbarer Brennstoff
OEO_00010150.definition: A liquid renewable fuel is a renewable fuel that has a liquid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010151.label: gasförmiger erneuerbarer Brennstoff
OEO_00010151.definition: A gaseous renewable fuel is a renewable fuel that has a gaseous state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010156.label: flüssiger synthetischer Brennstoff
OEO_00010156.definition: A liquid synthetic fuel is a synthetic fuel that has a liquid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00010221.label: synthetisches Ammoniak
OEO_00010221.definition: Synthetic ammonia is ammonia that has a synthetic origin.

OEO_00010224.label: fossiler Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00010224.definition: A fossil waste fuel is a waste fuel that has a fossil origin.

OEO_00010225.label: biogener Industrieabfallbrennstoff
OEO_00010225.definition: A biogenic industrial waste fuel is an industrial waste fuel that has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00010226.label: fossiler Industrieabfallbrennstoff
OEO_00010226.definition: A fossil industrial waste fuel is an industrial waste fuel that has a fossil origin.

OEO_00010237.label: verflüssigtes Erdgas (LNG)
OEO_00010237.definition: Liquefied natural gas (LNG) is natural gas that has a liquid state of matter.

OEO_00010241.label: Ottokraftstoff
OEO_00010241.definition: A gasoline fuel is a combustion fuel that has a gasoline fuel role.

OEO_00010242.label: Dieselkraftstoff
OEO_00010242.definition: A diesel fuel is a combustion fuel that has a diesel fuel role.

OEO_00010316.label: Mineralölprodukt
OEO_00010316.definition: A mineral oil product is a fossil combustion fuel produced in a mineral oil refining process.

OEO_00010317.label: Mineralöl
OEO_00010317.definition: A mineral oil is a fossil combustion fuel that is either crude oil or a mineral oil product.

OEO_00010326.label: Raffineriegas
OEO_00010326.definition: Refinery gas is a gas mixture that is produced as a by-product of a mineral oil refining process. It mainly consists of hydrogen, methane, ethane and olefins and can be used as a fuel.

OEO_00010327.label: Petrolkoks
OEO_00010327.definition: Petroleum coke is a portion of matter with a solid state of matter that is produced in a mineral oil refining process. It consists mainly of carbon and can be uses as a fuel.

OEO_00010336.label: nachhaltiger Biobrennstoff
OEO_00010336.definition: A sustainable biofuel is a biofuel that does conform to sustainability criteria.

OEO_00010337.label: nicht nachhaltiger Biobrennstoff
OEO_00010337.definition: A non-sustainable biofuel is a biofuel that does not conform to sustainability criteria.

OEO_00010379.label: Elektrolysewasserstoff
OEO_00010379.definition: Electrolytic hydrogen is hydrogen that is a physical output of a water electrolysis process.

OEO_00010380.label: erneuerbarer Elektrolysewasserstoff
OEO_00010380.definition: Renewable electrolytic hydrogen is electrolytic hydrogen that is produced with renewable electrical energy.

OEO_00010381.label: Wasserstoff aus Dampfreformierung
OEO_00010381.definition: Steam reforming hydrogen is hydrogen that is a physical output of a steam reforming process.

OEO_00010382.label: fossiler Wasserstoff aus Dampfreformierung
OEO_00010382.definition: Fossil steam reforming hydrogen is hydrogen that is produced from a fossil combustion fuel in a steam reforming process which is not followed by a carbon capture and storage process.

OEO_00010383.label: Wasserstoff aus Dampfreformierung mit CO2-Abscheidung
OEO_00010383.definition: Abated steam reforming hydrogen is hydrogen that is output of a steam reforming process which is followed by a carbon capture and storage process.

OEO_00010408.label: Brent-Rohöl
OEO_00010408.definition: Brent crude is a crude oil that is extracted in the North Sea and traded at ICE London.

OEO_00010409.label: West Texas Intermediate
OEO_00010409.definition: Western Texas Intermediate (WTI) is a crude oil that is extracted on US territory and traded at NYMEX New York.

OEO_00010416.label: Elektrolysewasserstoff aus Kernenergie
OEO_00010416.definition: Nuclear electrolytic hydrogen is electrolytic hydrogen that is produced with nuclear electrical energy.

OEO_00010418.label: Elektrolysewasserstoff aus Solarstrom
OEO_00010418.definition: Solar electrolytic hydrogen is electrolytic hydrogen that is produced with solar electrical energy.

OEO_00010445.label: Mischkraftstoff
OEO_00010445.definition: A blended liquid fuel is a liquid combustion fuel that contains a liquid fossil fuel and a liquid renewable fuel or a liquid biofuel.

OEO_00010446.label: Bioethanol
OEO_00010446.definition: Bioethanol is ethanol with a biogenic origin.

OEO_00010447.label: E10
OEO_00010447.definition: E10 is a gasoline fuel that consists of (fossil) gasoline and up to 10 % ethanol and that is liquid.

OEO_00010448.label: B7
OEO_00010448.definition: B7 is a diesel fuel that consists of fossil diesel fuel and up to 7 % biodiesel and that is liquid.

OEO_00010484.label: Methanol
OEO_00010484.definition: Methanol is a hydrocarbon with the chemical formula CH3OH. It has a liquid normal state of matter. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.

OEO_00020001.label: Ethanol
OEO_00020001.definition: Ethanol is a portion of matter with the chemical formula C2H6O. It has a liquid normal state of matter and can be used as a combustion fuel.

OEO_00020050.label: erneuerbarer Energieträger
OEO_00020050.definition: A renewable energy carrier is an energy carrier that has a renewable energy carrier disposition.

OEO_00020058.label: Gestein
OEO_00020058.definition: A rock is a portion of matter that is a naturally occurring solid aggregate of minerals or mineraloid matter that is part of the earth's crust.

OEO_00020196.label: spaltbares Material
OEO_00020196.definition: A fissile material entity is a material entity that has the disposition to carry nuclear (binding) energy.

OEO_00020494.label: Ethen
OEO_00020494.definition: Ethene, or colloquially Ethylene, is a hydrocarbon with the chemical formula H2C=CH2. It is gaseous in its normal state and can be used as a combustion fuel.

OEO_00020496.label: Kohleabraum
OEO_00020496.definition: Coal refuse is a fossil waste fuel that is the material left over from coal mining. It can partially be reused as fuel.

OEO_00020512.label: flüssiger Wasserstoff
OEO_00020512.definition: Liquid hydrogen is hydrogen that has been brought to a liquid state of matter at -253°C.

OEO_00020513.label: Wasserstoff aus Methanpyrolyse
OEO_00020513.definition: Methane pyrolytic hydrogen is synthetic hydrogen that is produced from pyrolysis of methane and solid CO2 storage.

OEO_00110000.label: flüssiges Wasser
OEO_00110000.definition: Liquid water is water that has a liquid state of matter.

OEO_00110001.label: Dampf
OEO_00110001.definition: Steam is water that has a gaseous state of matter.

OEO_00140078.label: Primärenergieträger
OEO_00140078.definition: A primary energy carrier is an energy carrier that has the disposition primary energy carrier disposition.

OEO_00140079.label: Sekundärenergieträger
OEO_00140079.definition: A secondary energy carrier is an energy carrier that has the secondary energy carrier disposition.

OEO_00140080.label: Endenergieträger
OEO_00140080.definition: A final energy carrier is an energy carrier that has the disposition final energy carrier disposition.

OEO_00140091.label: Plutonium
OEO_00140091.definition: Plutonium is a portion of matter with the chemical formula Pu. It has a solid normal state of matter.

OEO_00140092.label: Thorium
OEO_00140092.definition: Thorium is a portion of matter with the chemical formula Th. It has a solid normal state of matter.

OEO_00140159.label: Kohlenwasserstoff
OEO_00140159.definition: Hydrocarbon is a portion of matter which is member of class of organic chemical compounds composed only of the elements carbon (C) and hydrogen (H).

OEO_00140160.label: Synthesegas
OEO_00140160.definition: Syngas is a gas mixture consisting primarily of hydrogen, carbon monoxide, and very often carbon dioxide, that can be used as fuel.

OEO_00230021.label: Photon
OEO_00230021.definition: A photon is a material entity that is a light particle.

OEO_00320012.label: komprimiertes Erdgas (CNG)
OEO_00320012.definition: Compressed natural gas (CNG) is natural gas that has been compressed.

OEO_00320013.label: komprimiertes Biomethan
OEO_00320013.definition: Compressed biomethane is biomethane that has been compressed.

OEO_00320014.label: komprimiertes synthetisches Methan
OEO_00320014.definition: Compressed synthetic methane is synthetic methane that has been compressed.

OEO_00320015.label: Druckgaskraftstoff
OEO_00320015.definition: A compressed gas fuel is a combustion fuel that has a compressed gas fuel role.

out:total.label: Summe
out:total.definition: Die Zahl gilt für alle Energieträger zusammen: ihre Zeile oder Spalte summiert ausdrücklich über die Energieträger, oder ihre eigene Tabelle oder ihr Satz ist gar nicht nach Energieträgern aufgeteilt, nur nach anderem (Gebäudetyp, Sektor, Gebiet). Der Wärmebedarf der Gebäude eines Gebiets bleibt Summe, solange die Stelle nicht nach Energieträgern aufteilt.

out:other.label: Sonstige
out:other.definition: Etwas, das keiner der übrigen Einträge dieser Liste ist.

kg.label: refers to energy carrier
kg.note: Object is an OEO class (punning). The predicate is the MHPKG schema's slot, read from mhpkg_schema.yaml at serialization: refers to energy carrier. Its range is energy carrier, and the classes in outside_root are not under it in OEO; they are written all the same and counted, as input for the carrier axioms the ontology side is adding.

OEO_00000214.label: Private Haushalte
OEO_00000214.definition: A household sector is a sector that covers households.
OEO_00000214.gloss: Sektor für private Haushalte und Wohngebäude.

OEO_00000405.label: GHD
OEO_00000405.definition: A commercial sector is a sector that covers non-industrial commercial activities.

OEO_00000227.label: Industrie
OEO_00000227.definition: An industry sector is a sector that covers industrial activities with other main purposes of energy transformation.
OEO_00000227.gloss: Sektor für industrielle Aktivitäten mit Energiewandlung.

OEO_00000422.label: Verkehr
OEO_00000422.definition: A transport sector is a sector that covers transport of people and/or goods.
OEO_00000422.gloss: Sektor für den Transport von Personen und Gütern.

OEO_00010035.label: Landwirtschaft
OEO_00010035.definition: A agriculture, forestry and land use (AFOLU) sector is a sector that covers activities and natural processes from agriculture, forestry, land use and land use change.
OEO_00010035.gloss: Sektor für Landwirtschaft, Forstwirtschaft und Landnutzung.

OEO_00000128.label: Energienachfragesektor
OEO_00000128.definition: An energy demand sector is a sector that covers energy consumers.

OEO_00000145.label: Stromsektor
OEO_00000145.definition: An electricity sector is a transformation sector that covers electricity generation and transport of electrical energy to consumers of electrical energy.

OEO_00000158.label: Energieumwandlungssektor
OEO_00000158.definition: An energy transformation sector is a sector that covers energy production, energy transformation from primary to secondary energy and transport of energy to the demand sector.

OEO_00000213.label: Wärme- und Kältesektor
OEO_00000213.definition: A heating and cooling sector is a sector that covers heating and cooling activities.

OEO_00010034.label: Gebäudesektor
OEO_00010034.definition: A building sector is a sector that covers buildings.

OEO_00010036.label: Abfall- und Abwassersektor
OEO_00010036.definition: A waste and wastewater sector is a sector that covers activities related the collection and treatment of waste and wastewater.

OEO_00010319.label: Mineralölverarbeitung
OEO_00010319.definition: A mineral oil refining sector is an energy transformation sector that covers mineral oil refining.

OEO_00010320.label: internationaler Verkehr
OEO_00010320.definition: An international transport sector is a transport sector of international transport processes.

OEO_00010360.label: Quellgruppe
OEO_00010360.definition: A source category is a sector that is defined by a common reporting format.

OEO_00010464.label: Teilsektor
OEO_00010464.definition: A subsector is a sector that is a part of an other sector.

out:total.label: Summe
out:total.definition: Die Zahl gilt für alle Verbraucher zusammen: ihre Zeile oder Spalte summiert ausdrücklich über die Sektoren, sie heißt ausdrücklich Gesamtverbrauch oder Gesamtbedarf aller Verbraucher, oder ihre eigene Tabelle oder ihr Satz ist gar nicht nach Sektoren aufgeteilt, nur nach anderem (Energieträger, Gebiet). Ein Gebiet („Gesamtstadt“, „Stadtgebiet“) und die Gesamtleistung von Anlagen sind keine Summe über Sektoren.

out:other.label: Sonstige
out:other.definition: Etwas, das keiner der übrigen Einträge dieser Liste ist.

sector.question: Für welchen Verbrauchssektor gilt diese Zahl, oder, wo ihre Tabelle oder ihr Satz nicht nach Sektoren aufteilt, wonach teilt die Stelle stattdessen auf?

kg.label: refers to sector
kg.note: Object is an OEO sector class. The predicate is the MHPKG schema's slot, read from mhpkg_schema.yaml at serialization. A number its table does not split by sector (out:total) is written as total_class, the parent the schema names for a figure reported without a sector breakdown.

OEO_00020486.label: Wärmepumpe
OEO_00020486.definition: A heat pump technology is a heat generation technology that describes how to combine heat pumps, heat gain processes, energy carriers and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020486.gloss: Wärmepumpe: Kombiniert Wärmepumpen, Wärmegewinnungsprozesse und Energieträger zur Wärmeerzeugung.

OEO_00020307.label: Solarthermie
OEO_00020307.definition: A solar thermal heat technology is a heat generation technology that describes how to combine solar heat units, solar thermal energy transformation processes, energy carriers and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020307.gloss: Solarthermie: Nutzt Solareinheiten und solare Umwandlungsprozesse zur Wärmeerzeugung.

OEO_00020306.label: Geothermie
OEO_00020306.definition: A geothermal heat technology is a heat generation technology that describes how to combine geothermal heat units, geothermal heat transfer processes, energy carriers and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020306.gloss: Geothermie: Kombiniert geothermische Einheiten und Wärmeprozesse zur Wärmeerzeugung.

OEO_00020487.label: Direktelektrische Heizung
OEO_00020487.definition: An electrical heating technology is a technology that describes how to combine electrical heaters in a heat gain process with electrical energy as input in a specific way.
OEO_00020487.gloss: Direktelektrische Heizung: Wandelt elektrische Energie direkt in Wärme mittels elektrischer Heizelemente um.

OEO_00020491.label: Gasheizung
OEO_00020491.definition: An gas powered heating technology is a combustion-based heat generation technology that describes how to combine combustion-based heaters, heat gain processes, natural gas and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020491.gloss: Gasheizung: Verbrennungsbasierte Wärmeerzeugung unter Verwendung von Erdgas.

OEO_00020490.label: Ölheizung
OEO_00020490.definition: An oil powered heating technology is a combustion-based heat generation technology that describes how to combine combustion-based heaters, heat gain processes, heating oil and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020490.gloss: Ölheizung: Verbrennungsbasierte Wärmeerzeugung unter Verwendung von Heizöl.

OEO_00020493.label: Biomasseheizung
OEO_00020493.definition: A biomass powered heating technology is a combustion-based heat generation technology that describes how to combine biomass boilers, heat gain processes, biomass and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020493.gloss: Biomasseheizung: Verbrennungsbasierte Wärmeerzeugung unter Verwendung von Biomasse.

OEO_00020492.label: Wasserstoffheizung
OEO_00020492.definition: An hydrogen powered heating technology is a combustion-based heat generation technology that describes how to combine combustion-based heaters, heat gain processes, hydrogen and energy in a specific way.
OEO_00020492.gloss: Wasserstoffheizung: Verbrennungsbasierte Wärmeerzeugung unter Verwendung von Wasserstoff.

OEO_00020488.label: Verbrennungsbasierte Heizung
OEO_00020488.definition: A combustion based heating technology is a heat generation technology that describes how to combine combustion-based heaters, heat gain processes, combustion fuels and energy in a specific way.

OEO_00020489.label: Kohleheizung
OEO_00020489.definition: A coal powered heating technology is a combustion-based heat generation technology that describes how to combine combustion-based heaters, heat gain processes, coal and energy in a specific way.

out:total.label: Summe
out:total.definition: Die Zahl gilt für alle Wärmeerzeuger zusammen: ihre Zeile oder Spalte summiert ausdrücklich über die Technologien, oder ihre eigene Tabelle oder ihr Satz ist gar nicht nach Heiztechniken aufgeteilt, nur nach anderem. Ein Energieträger allein („Erdgas“) ist keine Technologie, eine „Gasheizung“ schon.

out:other.label: Sonstige
out:other.definition: Etwas, das keiner der übrigen Einträge dieser Liste ist.

technology.question: Welcher Wärmeerzeugungstechnologie ordnet der Plan diese Zahl ausdrücklich zu, oder, wo ihre Tabelle oder ihr Satz nicht nach Technologien aufteilt, wonach teilt die Stelle stattdessen auf?

kg.label: refers to technology
kg.note: Object is an OEO heat generation technology class (punning), the MHPKG schema's slot. A number not split by technology (out:total) writes no edge: the schema's slot is optional.

year.question: Für welches Kalenderjahr oder welchen Zeitraum von Jahren gilt diese Zahl?

kg.label: has scenario year value
kg.note: The calendar year as an integer literal, as the MHPKG schema's slot has it. A unit entry that names no period carries the flag period:unstated.

target.label: Zielszenario
target.definition: Der angestrebte Zustand eines künftigen Jahres, wie der Plan ihn erreichen will, auch unter einem eigenen Namen des Plans („bei erhöhter Energieeinsparung“, „Umsetzungsszenario 2“, „Transformationspfad“).

status_quo.label: Bestand
status_quo.definition: Erhoben oder bilanziert für ein vergangenes oder das laufende Jahr: Bestandsanalyse, Ist-Zustand, Bilanzjahr, Ausgangslage, Energiebilanz, „bislang“, „derzeit“, „wird verbraucht“, oder ein Jahr vor der Erstellung des Plans im Titel.

scenario.question: Auf welchen Zustand des Plans bezieht sich diese Zahl, auf seinen Bestand, ein Trend- oder ein Zielszenario?

trend.note: with existing measures scenario. Not OEO_00020314 reference scenario: that one is defined by a ROLE (`scenario and has role some reference role`) and carries no content, so it says a scenario was used as a comparison and not what it assumes. A Trendszenario is the continuation under the measures already decided, which is what WEM means.

kg.note: Which container node holds the value: the plan has the container by `linked_by`, and the edge from the container down to the value is structural and named in kg.py. Only the target scenario is serialized today (G2).

municipality.label: Gemeindegebiet
municipality.definition: Das ganze Gemeinde- oder Stadtgebiet des Plans.

sub_area.label: Teilgebiet
sub_area.definition: Ein benannter Teil davon, ein Quartier, ein Fokusgebiet, ein Wärmenetzgebiet, mit seinem Namen.

spatial_scope.question: Für welches Gebiet gilt diese Zahl, für die ganze Gemeinde oder für ein Teilgebiet mit seinem Namen?

municipality.note: the plan's own area, minted from the AGS

kg.note: The schema has no relation from a value to its area, so a sub_area value is serialized with the area in its IRI and its comment but without an edge to the area node. Not TERM REQUEST 1, which asks for the plan's area.

parameters.label: Emissionen
parameters.description: Eine im Wärmeplan bilanzierte Emissionsmenge, je Energieträger, Sektor und Jahr, oder ein Emissionsfaktor, die Emission je Einheit Aktivität, etwa g CO2/kWh. Welche Größe es ist, wählst du in "quantity" aus der Liste. Die Ontologie definiert die beiden Klassen so: CO2 emission value ist "a greenhouse gas emission value that quantifies a CO2 emission rate and has a mass unit", also reines Kohlendioxid. carbon dioxide equivalent quantity value ist "the combined effect of all emitted greenhouse gases by giving an equivalent amount of CO2", also alle Treibhausgase in CO2-Äquivalenten. Die Einheit verrät es meist: t CO2 gegen t CO2-Äq. Dazu stehen in der Liste die Oberklassen greenhouse gas emission value und emission value, wo die Stelle nicht sagt, welche Gase gemeint sind, und emission factor value, "a fraction value that quantifies an emission factor as quotient of the emissions or removals of a gas per unit activity". Die Einträge out: sind Größen ohne Klasse der Ontologie, etwa eine kumulierte Summe über mehrere Jahre, eine vermiedene Emission oder eine abgeschiedene Menge aus einer CCS-Anlage. Wähle den passenden davon, wenn die Zahl eine davon ist. Das ist ein richtiges Ergebnis, kein Fehler.
parameters.brief: Eine Emissionsmenge, die der Wärmeplan bilanziert, je Energieträger, Sektor und Jahr: Kohlendioxid oder alle Treibhausgase in CO2-Äquivalenten, auch eine kumulierte, vermiedene oder abgeschiedene Menge. Auch ein Emissionsfaktor, die Emission je Einheit Aktivität, etwa g CO2/kWh.

OEO_00340066.label: CO2 emission value
OEO_00340066.definition: A CO2 emission value is a greenhouse gas emission value that quantifies a CO2 emission rate and has a mass unit.
OEO_00340066.gloss: CO2-Emissionswert: Quantifiziert eine CO2-Emissionsrate mit Masseneinheit, nur Kohlendioxid, etwa in t CO2.

OEO_00140083.label: carbon dioxide equivalent quantity value
OEO_00140083.definition: A carbon dioxide equivalent quantity is a greenhouse gas emission value that quantifies the combined effect of all emitted greenhouse gases by giving an equivalent amount of CO2 which would have the same effect on the climate.
OEO_00140083.gloss: CO2-Äquivalent: Quantifiziert die kombinierte Wirkung aller Treibhausgase als CO2-Äquivalent, etwa in t CO2-Äq., auch wo eine Festlegung des Plans seine Emissionen in CO2-Äquivalenten angibt und die Kopfzeile nur CO2 nennt.

OEO_00010079.label: Emissionswert
OEO_00010079.definition: An emission value is a quantity value that quantifies an emission rate and has a mass unit.

OEO_00340065.label: Treibhausgasemissionswert
OEO_00340065.definition: A greenhouse gas emission value is an emission value that quantifies a greenhouse gas emission rate and has a mass unit.

OEO_00340063.label: Emissionsfaktor
OEO_00340063.definition: An emission factor value is a fraction value that quantifies an emission factor as quotient of the emissions or removals of a gas per unit activity.

out:cumulative.label: kumulierte Emission über mehrere Jahre
out:cumulative.definition: Über mehrere Jahre aufsummiert, keine Jahresmenge.

out:avoided.label: vermiedene oder eingesparte Emission
out:avoided.definition: Eine vermiedene oder eingesparte Emission, das Gegenteil einer ausgestoßenen.

out:captured.label: abgeschiedene oder gespeicherte Emission
out:captured.definition: Eine abgeschiedene oder gespeicherte Menge, das Gegenteil einer ausgestoßenen.

out:share.label: Anteil in Prozent
out:share.definition: Ein Anteil in Prozent, keine Menge.

out:specific.label: Emission je Kopf oder je Einwohner
out:specific.definition: Ein Wert je Fläche, Kopf oder Gebäude, keine Gesamtmenge.

out:other.label: etwas anderes
out:other.definition: Etwas, das keiner der übrigen Einträge dieser Liste ist.

kg.note: The class of the value node itself (rdf:type). An out:* answer is a deliberate non-class and mints no node.

what.question: Welche Bezeichnung gibt der Plan genau dieser Zahl, in ihrer Zeile, ihrem Spaltenkopf, dem Titel ihrer Tabelle oder Abbildung oder ihrem Satz?

subject.question: Welcher Eintrag ihrer eigenen Zeile oder ihres Satzes unterscheidet diese Zahl von den Zahlen neben ihr, etwa eine Baualtersklasse, ein Gebäudetyp, eine Zone, ein Netz, eine Ausbaustufe oder eine Variante, und ist weder Energieträger, Sektor, Jahr, Gebiet noch der Name einer Spalte?

out:approximate.label: ungefähr
out:approximate.definition: Der Plan nennt die Zahl als ungefähren Wert.

out:at_most.label: höchstens
out:at_most.definition: Der Plan nennt die Zahl als Obergrenze: Der Wert ist höchstens so groß.

out:at_least.label: mindestens
out:at_least.definition: Der Plan nennt die Zahl als Untergrenze: Der Wert ist mindestens so groß.

out:range_low.label: unteres Ende einer Spanne
out:range_low.definition: Die kleinere von zwei Zahlen, zwischen denen der Wert liegt.

out:range_high.label: oberes Ende einer Spanne
out:range_high.definition: Die größere von zwei Zahlen, zwischen denen der Wert liegt.

qualifier.question: Welches Wort direkt bei dieser Zahl sagt, wie genau sie gilt, etwa „ca.“, „bis zu“, „mehr als“ oder „zwischen“?

OEO_00140070.label: integral
spellings: Summe oder Integral über einen Zeitraum oder ein Gebiet
OEO_00140070.definition: sum or integral of values, e.g. within a time step or a spatial region
OEO_00140070.gloss: Summe oder Integral von Werten innerhalb eines Zeitraums oder Gebiets, etwa eine Jahressumme, der Normalfall.

OEO_00140071.label: arithmetic mean
OEO_00140071.definition: average value calculated by arithmetic mean over a set of data values, e.g. within a time step or spatial region
OEO_00140071.gloss: Durchschnittswert, berechnet als arithmetisches Mittel über Datensätze.

OEO_00140069.label: instantaneous
OEO_00140069.definition: value measured at or modelled for exactly one 0-dim temporal region, referenced by a time stamp, e.g. to represent a time step in a time series
OEO_00140069.gloss: Wert, der exakt zu einem zeitlichen Nullpunkt gemessen oder modelliert wird.

OEO_00140073.label: maximum
OEO_00140073.definition: maximum value within a set of data values, e.g. in a time step or spatial region
OEO_00140073.gloss: Höchster Wert innerhalb einer Menge von Datenwerten in einem Bereich.

OEO_00140072.label: minimum
OEO_00140072.definition: minimum value within a set of data values, e.g. in a time step or spatial region
OEO_00140072.gloss: Niedrigster Wert innerhalb einer Menge von Datenwerten in einem Bereich.

aggregation.question: Wie fasst diese Zahl Werte über Zeit oder Raum zusammen?

kg.label: has aggregation type
kg.note: Object is a named individual of OEO_00140068 aggregation type. Asked; where no answer is read, derived from a unit that converts onto the parameter's own unit.

OEO_00000292.label: Erdgas
OEO_00000292.definition: Natural gas is a gas mixture occurring in underground deposits, whether liquefied or gaseous, and consisting mainly of methane.
OEO_00000292.gloss: Erdgas: Gasgemisch aus unterirdischen Lagerstätten, das hauptsächlich aus Methan besteht.

OEO_00000211.label: Heizöl
OEO_00000211.definition: Heating oil is gas diesel oil for industrial and commercial uses, marine diesel and diesel used in rail traffic, other gas oil, including heavy gas oils which distil between 380 °C and 540 °C and which are used as petrochemical feedstocks.
OEO_00000211.gloss: Heizöl: Gasöl für industrielle und gewerbliche Zwecke, auch schwere Gasöle, die als petrochemische Rohstoffe dienen.

OEO_00000132.label: Fernwärme
OEO_00000132.definition: District heating is a grid-bound heating transfer to residential or commercial buildings.
OEO_00000132.gloss: Fernwärme: Leitungsgebundene Wärmelieferung an Wohn- oder Gewerbegebäude.

OEO_00000139.label: Strom
OEO_00000139.definition: Electrical energy is a form of energy derived from the potential or kinetic energy of charged particles.
OEO_00000139.gloss: Elektrische Energie aus geladenen Teilchen, unterscheidet sich als nicht-materieller Energieträger.

OEO_00000449.label: Holz
OEO_00000449.definition: Wood is a biomass from trees. It has a solid state of matter an can be used as fuel.
OEO_00000449.gloss: Holz: Biomasse von Bäumen in festem Aggregatzustand, die als Brennstoff genutzt werden kann.

OEO_00000074.label: Biogas
OEO_00000074.definition: Biogas is a gas mixture produced by anaerobic digestion. It consists mainly of methane and carbon dioxide and can be used as fuel.
OEO_00000074.gloss: Biogas: Durch anaerobe Vergärung entstehendes Gasgemisch aus hauptsächlich Methan und Kohlendioxid, das als Brennstoff dient.

OEO_00000388.label: Solarthermie
OEO_00000388.definition: Solar thermal energy is thermal energy that is the physical output of a solar thermal energy transformation.
OEO_00000388.gloss: Solarthermie: Wärmeenergie, die als Ergebnis einer solarthermischen Energieumwandlung entsteht.

OEO_00000251.label: Braunkohle
OEO_00000251.definition: Lignite is coal that is non-agglomerating with a gross calorific value less than 17 435 kJ/kg (4 165 kcal/kg) and greater than 31 % volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.
OEO_00000251.gloss: Braunkohle: Nicht backende Kohle mit einem Brennwert unter 17 435 kJ/kg und über 31 % flüchtigen Bestandteilen.

OEO_00320011.label: Flüssiggas
OEO_00320011.definition: Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) is gas mixture of hydrocarbon gases, mainly propane and butane.
OEO_00320011.gloss: Flüssiggasgemisch aus Propan und Butan, unterscheidet sich als fossiler Gasbrennstoff.

OEO_00000220.label: Wasserstoff
OEO_00000220.definition: Hydrogen is a portion of matter with the chemical formula H2. It has a gaseous normal state of matter. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.
OEO_00000220.gloss: Wasserstoff: Stoff mit der chemischen Formel H2, der gasförmig vorliegt und als Brennstoff verwendet werden kann.

OEO_00000204.label: Steinkohle
OEO_00000204.definition: Hard coal is coal with a gross calorific value greater than 23 865 kJ/kg (5 700 kcal/kg) on an ashfree but moist basis and with a mean random reflectance of vitrinite of at least 0,6.
OEO_00000204.gloss: Steinkohle: Kohle mit einem Brennwert über 23 865 kJ/kg und einer mittleren Vitrinitreflexion von mindestens 0,6.

OEO_00010215.label: Biomethan
OEO_00010215.definition: Biomethane is a gas mixture produced from biogas by removing carbon dioxide. It consists mainly of methane and can be used as fuel.
OEO_00010215.gloss: Biomethan: Aus Biogas durch Abtrennung von Kohlendioxid gewonnenes Gasgemisch aus hauptsächlich Methan, das als Brennstoff dient.

OEO_00000332.label: biogener Festbrennstoff
OEO_00000332.definition: Solid biomass is a portion of matter consisting of organic, non-fossil material of biological origin which may be used as fuel for heat production or electricity generation.
OEO_00000332.gloss: Biogener Festbrennstoff: Organisches, nicht fossiles Material biologischen Ursprungs, das zur Wärme- oder Stromerzeugung genutzt werden kann.

OEO_00010214.label: Biomasse
OEO_00010214.definition: Biomass is a portion of matter from plants or animals and has thus has a biogenic origin.
OEO_00010214.gloss: Biomasse: Stoff pflanzlichen oder tierischen Ursprungs und damit biogener Herkunft.

OEO_00000088.label: Kohle
OEO_00000088.definition: Coal is a portion of matter consisting of combustible black or brownish-black sedimentary rock, formed as rock strata called coal seams.
OEO_00000088.gloss: Kohle: Brennbares schwarzes bis schwarzbraunes Sedimentgestein, das in Flözen entstanden ist.

OEO_00000290.label: Siedlungsabfälle
OEO_00000290.definition: A municipal waste fuel is waste fuel produced by households or non-industrial commercial activities.
OEO_00000290.gloss: Siedlungsabfälle: Abfallbrennstoff aus Haushalten oder nicht-industriellen gewerblichen Tätigkeiten.

OEO_00000356.label: biogener Siedlungsabfall
OEO_00000356.definition: A biogenic municipal waste fuel is a municipal waste fuel that has a biogenic origin.
OEO_00000356.gloss: Siedlungsabfall mit biogenem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich durch die biologische Herkunft.

OEO_00000439.label: Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00000439.definition: A waste fuel is a fuel in which the material entity is waste.
OEO_00000439.gloss: Brennstoff, bei dem das Material Abfall ist, umfasst alle Abfallarten.

OEO_00020495.label: landwirtschaftlicher Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00020495.definition: An angricultural waste fuel is waste fuel produced by agriculture.
OEO_00020495.gloss: Landwirtschaftlicher Abfallbrennstoff: Abfallbrennstoff aus der Landwirtschaft.

OEO_00010155.label: synthetische Gase
OEO_00010155.definition: A gaseous synthetic fuel is a synthetic fuel that has a gaseous state of matter under normal conditions.
OEO_00010155.gloss: Synthetische Gase: Synthetischer Brennstoff, der unter Normalbedingungen gasförmig ist.

OEO_00000191.label: Geothermie
OEO_00000191.definition: Geothermal energy is thermal energy that is released from within the earth's crust.
OEO_00000191.gloss: Geothermie: Wärmeenergie, die aus dem Inneren der Erdkruste freigesetzt wird.

OEO_00010114.label: Abwärme
OEO_00010114.definition: Waste thermal energy is thermal energy that is the physical output of an energy transformation process and that is released into the environment unused.
OEO_00010114.gloss: Abwärme: Wärmeenergie, die bei einem Energieumwandlungsprozess entsteht und ungenutzt an die Umwelt abgegeben wird.

OEO_00310004.label: industrielle Abwärme
OEO_00310004.definition: Industrial waste thermal energy is waste thermal energy that is energy output of some industrial process.
OEO_00310004.gloss: Industrielle Abwärme: Abwärme, die als Energieausgabe eines industriellen Prozesses entsteht.

OEO_00000056.label: Umweltwärme
OEO_00000056.definition: Ambient thermal energy is thermal energy that is stored in the ambient air, beneath the surface of solid earth or in surface water. It is captured by heat pumps.
OEO_00000056.gloss: In Luft, Erde oder Wasser gespeicherte Wärme, die durch Wärmepumpen genutzt wird.

OEO_00140105.label: anthropogene Umweltwärme
OEO_00140105.definition: Artificial ambient thermal energy is ambient thermal energy that has an anthropogenic origin.
OEO_00140105.gloss: Umweltwärme mit anthropogenem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich durch menschliche Entstehung.

OEO_00140104.label: natürliche Umweltwärme
OEO_00140104.definition: Natural ambient thermal energy is ambient thermal energy that has a renewable origin.
OEO_00140104.gloss: Umweltwärme mit erneuerbarem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich durch natürliche Herkunft.

OEO_00010223.label: biogener Abfallbrennstoff
OEO_00010223.definition: A biogenic waste fuel is a waste fuel that has a biogenic origin.
OEO_00010223.gloss: Abfallbrennstoff mit biogenem Ursprung, unterscheidet sich als spezifische Abfallart.

OEO_00000014.label: fossiler Brennstoff
OEO_00000014.definition: A fossil combustion fuel is a combustion fuel with the origin fossil.

OEO_00000025.label: Methan
OEO_00000025.definition: Methane is a hydrocarbon with the chemical formula CH4. It has a gaseous normal state of matter. It occurs naturally in the atmosphere as a trace gas and can work as a greenhouse gas. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.

OEO_00000033.label: erneuerbarer Brennstoff
OEO_00000033.definition: A renewable fuel is a fuel that has a renewable origin and an renewable energy carrier disposition

OEO_00000040.label: Uran
OEO_00000040.definition: Uranium is a portion of matter that has the atomic number 92. It is a silver-grey metal.

OEO_00000054.label: Luft
OEO_00000054.definition: Air is a gas mixture that forms the Earth's atmosphere.

OEO_00000058.label: Anthrazit
OEO_00000058.definition: Anthracite is a hard coal with a high caloric value due to its high carbon content (about 90 % fixed carbon).

OEO_00000062.label: Erdölbegleitgas
OEO_00000062.definition: Associated gas is a natural gas that is a byproduct from crude oil exploitation.

OEO_00000066.label: Flugbenzin
OEO_00000066.definition: Aviation gasoline is gasoline used as motor spirit and prepared especially for aviation piston engines, with an octane number suited to the engine, a freezing point of -60 °C and a distillation range usually within the limits of 30 °C and 180 °C.

OEO_00000071.label: Biodiesel
OEO_00000071.definition: Biodiesel is a portion of matter that has a liquid state of matter and has a diesel fuel role. It is produced from plants or animals and thus has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00000072.label: Biobrennstoff
OEO_00000072.definition: A biofuel is a combustion fuel that has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00000075.label: Bio-Ottokraftstoff
OEO_00000075.definition: Biogasoline is a portion of matter that has a liquid state of matter and has a gasoline fuel role. It consists of bioethanol, biomethanol and products of these two substances. It is made from vegetable or animal material and thus has a biogenic origin.

OEO_00000077.label: Gichtgas
OEO_00000077.definition: Blast furnace gas is manufactured coal based gas produced during the combustion of coke in blast furnaces in the iron and steel industry. It is recovered and used as a fuel partly within the plant and partly in other steel industry processes or in power stations equipped to burn it. The quantity of fuel should be reported on a gross calorific value basis.

OEO_00000084.label: Holzkohle
OEO_00000084.definition: Charcoal is a portion of matter produced from wood via pyrolysis. It has a solid state of matter and can be used as fuel.

OEO_00000093.label: Kokereigas
OEO_00000093.definition: Coke oven gas is manufactured coal based gas obtained as a by-product of the manufacture of coke oven coke for the production of iron and steel.

OEO_00000094.label: Kokskohle
OEO_00000094.definition: Coking coal is hard coal that is bituminous with a quality that allows the production of a coke suitable to support a blast furnace charge. Its gross calorific value is greater than 23 865 kJ/kg (5 700 kcal/kg) on an ash-free but moist basis.

OEO_00000096.label: Grubengas
OEO_00000096.definition: Colliery gas is natural gas found in coal mines (British English: colliery). The main component is methane. Synonyms are firedamp, mine gas. It is used as a fossil fuel.

OEO_00000099.label: Verbrennungsbrennstoff
OEO_00000099.definition: A combustion fuel is a fuel that realises its fuel role in processes that release energy in the form of heat or work by chemical reaction with other substances.

OEO_00000102.label: Druckluft
OEO_00000102.definition: Compressed air is air that has been compressed to store energy. To discharge energy, the air is expanded.

OEO_00000115.label: Rohöl
OEO_00000115.definition: Crude oil is a portion of mater of fossil origin comprising a mixture of hydrocarbons and associated impurities, such as sulphur. It exists in the liquid phase under normal surface temperature and pressure and its physical characteristics (density, viscosity, etc.) are highly variable. This category includes field or lease condensate recovered from associated and non-associated gas where it is commingled with the commercial crude oil stream.

OEO_00000131.label: fossiler Dieselkraftstoff
OEO_00000131.definition: Diesel fuel is gas diesel oil used on-road for diesel compression ignition (cars, trucks, etc.), usually of low sulphur content.

OEO_00000173.label: Brennstoff
OEO_00000173.definition: A fuel is a portion of matter that has the disposition to be an energy carrier and that has a fuel role.

OEO_00000181.label: Gasöl
OEO_00000181.definition: Gas/diesel oil is a portion of matter that is primarily a medium distillate distilling between 180 °C and 380 °C. Includes blending components. Several grades are available depending on uses.

OEO_00000183.label: Benzin
OEO_00000183.definition: Gasoline (American English) or petrol (British English) is a portion of matter in the form of a transparent petroleum-derived liquid that is used primarily as a fuel in spark-ignited internal combustion engines. It consists mostly of organic compounds obtained by the fractional distillation of petroleum, enhanced with a variety of additives.

OEO_00000186.label: Stadtgas
OEO_00000186.definition:
Gasworks gas is manufactured coal based gas that covers all types of gases produced in public utility or private plants, whose main purpose is manufacture, transport and distribution of gas. It includes gas produced by carbonisation (including gas produced by coke ovens and transferred to gasworks gas), by total gasification with or without enrichment with oil products (LPG, residual fuel oil, etc.), and by reforming and simple mixing of gases and/or air, reported under the rows ‘from other sources’. Under the transformation sector identify amounts of gasworks gas transferred to blended natural gas which will be distributed and consumed through the natural gas grid.

The production of other coal gases (i.e. coke oven gas, blast furnace gas and oxygen steel furnace gas) should be reported in the columns concerning such gases, and not as production of gasworks gas. The coal gases transferred to gasworks plants should then be reported (in their own column) in the transformation sector in the gasworks plants row. The total amount of gasworks gas resulting from transfers of other coal gases should appear in the production line for gasworks gas.

OEO_00000226.label: Industrieabfallbrennstoff
OEO_00000226.definition: An industrial waste fuel is waste fuel produced by industry.

OEO_00000245.label: Düsenkraftstoff
OEO_00000245.definition: Jet fuel is kerosene used for aviation turbine power units. It has the same distillation characteristics between 150 °C and 300 °C (generally not above 250 °C) and flash point as kerosene. In addition, it has particular specifications (such as freezing point) which are established by the International Air Transport Association (IATA).

OEO_00000246.label: Kerosin
OEO_00000246.definition:
Kerosene, also known as paraffin, lamp oil, and coal oil (an obsolete term), is a portion of matter consisting of combustible hydrocarbon liquid which is derived from petroleum. It is widely used as a fuel in industry as well as households. It is sometimes spelled kerosine in scientific and industrial usage.
[...]

Kerosene is widely used to power jet engines of aircraft (jet fuel) and some rocket engines and is also commonly used as a cooking and lighting fuel and for fire toys such as poi. In parts of Asia, kerosene is sometimes used as fuel for small outboard motors or even motorcycles.

OEO_00000257.label: Flüssigluft
OEO_00000257.definition: Liquid air is air that has a liquid state of matter.

OEO_00000258.label: flüssiger Biobrennstoff
OEO_00000258.definition: A liquid biofuel is a biofuel that has liquid as its normal state of matter.

OEO_00000263.label: Gas aus Kohle
OEO_00000263.definition: A manufactured coal based gas is a gas mixture that is manufactured from coal. It is used as fossil fuel.

OEO_00000286.label: Motorenbenzin
OEO_00000286.definition:
Motor gasoline is gasoline consisting of a mixture of light hydrocarbons distilling between 35 °C and 215 °C. It is used as a fuel for land based spark ignition engines. Motor gasoline may include additives, oxygenates and octane enhancers, including lead compounds such as TEL and TML.

Includes motor gasoline blending components (excluding additives/oxygenates), e.g. alkylates, isomerate, reformate, cracked gasoline destined for use as finished motor gasoline.

OEO_00000297.label: Erdgas aus reinen Gasfeldern
OEO_00000297.definition: Non associated gas is natural gas originating from fields producing hydrocarbons only in gaseous form.

OEO_00000299.label: fossiler Siedlungsabfall
OEO_00000299.definition: A fossil municipal waste fuel is an municipal waste fuel that has a fossil origin.

OEO_00000302.label: Kernbrennstoff
OEO_00000302.definition: A nuclear fuel is a fuel that realises its fuel role in processes that release energy in the form of heat or work by undergoing nuclear fission.

OEO_00000320.label: Torf
OEO_00000320.definition: Peat is a or portion of matter that is a soft, porous or compressed, sedimentary deposit of plant origin with high water content (up to 90 % in the raw state) and can be used as combustion fuel. As the natural formation of peat takes at least centuries, peat is usually considered having a fossil origin.

OEO_00000345.label: hochgepumptes Wasser
OEO_00000345.definition: Pumped water is liquid water which was pumped into an upper reservoir and thus contains potential energy.

OEO_00000391.label: fester fossiler Brennstoff
OEO_00000391.definition: A solid fossil fuel is a fossil fuel that has a solid state of matter under normal conditions.

OEO_00000401.label: subbituminöse Kohle
OEO_00000401.definition: Sub bituminous coal is coal that is non-agglomerating with a gross calorific value between 17 435 kJ/kg (4 165 kcal/kg) and 23 865 kJ/kg (5 700 kcal/kg) containing more than 31 % volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

OEO_00000441.label: Wasser
OEO_00000441.definition: Water is a portion of matter with the chemical formula H2O. It has a liquid normal state of matter.

OEO_00010000.label: Ammoniak
OEO_00010000.definition: Ammonia is a portion of matter with the chemical formula NH3. It has a gaseous normal state of matter and can act as an air pollutant. As it can be oxidised it can be used as a fuel.

OEO_00010015.label: fossiler Wasserstoff
